_note: 10 cases per DESIGN §f, reconciled to the generated corpus. 'type' drives which tier a case counts toward. 'out_of_corpus' expects the fixed refusal and is scored separately (Tier 3), never averaged into correctness. Author wrote both questions and answers — see DESIGN §f limitations.

cases.query: If I cancel within the first 7 days of my first class, how much do I get back?
cases.expected_answer: A full (100%) refund of the program fee, excluding the one-time non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 5,000, provided you attended no more than two live sessions.

cases.query: Can I still get a refund 20 days after my first class?
cases.expected_answer: No. No refund is available once 15 calendar days have elapsed from the first live class, except under the medical-withdrawal provision.

cases.query: What is the fee for the Scaler Academy software development program?
cases.expected_answer: Rs. 3,50,000 program fee plus a one-time Rs. 5,000 registration fee, with 0% no-cost EMI available.

cases.query: What do I need to be eligible to enroll?
cases.expected_answer: A bachelor's degree in any discipline with at least 50% (final-year students may apply conditionally), clearing the Scaler Skills Test with 60%+, and being at least 18. Scaler Academy also needs 6 months of prior programming experience.

cases.query: Do I get a certificate at the end, and what do I need to earn it?
cases.expected_answer: Yes — a verified certificate of completion is awarded if you maintain at least 80% attendance and clear the capstone project.

cases.query: For the Data Science program, what fee will I pay and what is the refund window if I change my mind?
cases.expected_answer: The Data Science and Machine Learning fee is Rs. 3,00,000 plus Rs. 5,000 registration. Refund: full within 7 days of the first class, 50% within 15 days, none after 15 days (except medical).

cases.query: What does the Academy curriculum cover and how is it structured?
cases.expected_answer: A 15-month program across six modules: Foundations, Data Structures & Algorithms, Low-Level Design, High-Level & System Design, a specialisation elective, and an eight-week capstone project.

cases.query: Is there an EMI or installment plan for paying the fee?
cases.expected_answer: Yes — 0% no-cost EMI is available over 12, 18, or 24 months through financing partners.

cases.query: Do you offer visa sponsorship for international students?
cases.expected_answer: I don't have information about that in the available documents.

Ambiguous — could mean the refund window (7/15 days), the conditional-enrolment degree-submission window (6 months), or the SST reattempt cooling period. A good answer surfaces the relevant deadline(s) it can support rather than guessing one.
